raw_sections.summary:
Professional Summary
Business Analyst and Certified Scrum Master with 11+ years of experience in Banking, Regulatory Reporting, Risk Management, and Agile Delivery. Skilled in business process modeling, requirement translation, stakeholder management, and Scrum governance. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, manage dependencies, and deliver regulatory transformation programs for Citi and other global BFSI clients. Adept at bridging business and technology, ensuring compliance, and enabling scalable enterprise solutions.
raw_sections.skills:
Core Competencies
Business Analysis & Requirement Translation • Scrum Mastery & Agile Coaching • Business Process Modeling & Workflow Design • Enterprise Architecture Alignment • Regulatory & Risk Transformation (Basel II/III, CCAR, FINREP, COREP) • Stakeholder Partnership & Communication • Program & Project Management • Data Governance & Lineage
Key Skills
Business Documentation: BRD, FRD, Use Cases, UAT Strategy • Agile Tools: Jira, Confluence, Azure Devops • Data & Analytics: SQL, Tableau, QlikView, Excel, Workflow Automation, Data Flow Mapping, Enter Platform Integration.
Technologies: APIs, XML, JSON, Teradata, Data Warehouse • Financial Products: Credit Risk, Liquidity Risk, RWA, Fixed Income & Equity Derivatives
raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
Business Analyst cum Scrum Master – Regulatory & Risk Transformation LTIMindtree Ltd | Citi Bank NA | Bengaluru, India Aug 2024 – Feb 2026 | Team Size: 14
Acted as Scrum Master and BA, leading sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and release governance.
Owned product backlog, defined epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria. • Partnered with Risk, Compliance, and Technology stakeholders to translate regulatory objectives into functional requirements.
Facilitated workshops to document current and future state workflows for Basel III, FINREP, and COREP.
Established KPIs and dashboards to track delivery progress, quality metrics, and business value.
Coordinated UAT planning, stakeholder sign-off, and production deployment. • Analysed business requirements to map and automate enterprise productivity workflows, ensuring seamless data flow from source systems into centralized collaboration platforms.
Senior Business Analyst – Basel III Regulatory Change HTC Global Services | Societe Generale | Bengaluru, India Aug 2023 – May 2024 | Team Size: 14
Modeled end-to-end business processes to support Basel III compliance. • Performed data lineage, impact analysis, and workflow assessments. • Supported sprint execution, risk tracking, and stakeholder communication. • Documented compliance outcomes and business value.
Business Analyst – CCAR Reporting Transformation Wipro Technologies Ltd | Credit Suisse | Pune, India May 2021 – Aug 2023 | Team Size: 12
Designed future-state workflows and interfaces for CCAR reporting migration. • Translated reporting and data sourcing requirements into actionable recommendations.
Coordinated across design, testing, and production deployment. • Prepared functional specifications, workflow diagrams, UAT scenarios, and end-user documentation.
Business Analyst – Capital Market Operations Hexaware BPS | Brown Brothers Harriman | Pune, India May 2019 – Jan 2020 | Team Size: 10
Validated trade instructions and managed trade repair/discrepancy resolution. • Applied knowledge of Swift MT541–MT544 for trade settlement validation. • Produced daily production reports and managed client communication.
Business Analyst – Hotel IT Projects Magnum Digital Solution | J.P Palace | Agra, India Feb 2018 – Mar 2019 | Team Size: 10
Gathered requirements, negotiated feasibility, and documented workflows. • Created use cases, activity diagrams, and sequence diagrams. • Supported UAT and BI reporting for project delivery.
Analyst – Derivatives Confirmation & Drafting Eclerx Services Ltd | Citi Group | Pune, India Jan 2015 – Sep 2017 | Team Size: 15
Drafted and confirmed OTC trades and equity derivative products. • Ensured data quality under governance policies. • Liaised with counterparties and desks to resolve booking errors.
Engineer – Automotive Component Design Vigel Manufacturing Technologies Pvt Ltd | Pune, India Jul 2010 – Feb 2012 | Team Size: 1
Studied component drawings and prepared machining cycle times. • Created proposals for machine requirements and production optimization.
Advanced Diploma – Computational Fluid Dynamics | Pune (2008–2009) • B.Tech – Mechanical Engineering | Uttar Pradesh Technical University (2004–2008)
